recognize_zh: 紅色膜染色的大型細胞密集成片、彼此相連，不再是散在於小淋巴球之間的孤立細胞；大型陽性細胞成片生長代表 NLPHL 已進展為瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤（DLBCL）。
features: Confluent sheets of large cells with strong membranous red chromogen staining
Large cells have oval to irregular vesicular nuclei with moderate cytoplasm
Positive cells abut one another without an intervening small-lymphocyte background
Scattered negative endothelial-lined vessels and stromal cells
Only few interspersed small negative cells
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen; antigen not labeled, membranous pattern consistent with a B-cell marker such as CD20) shows confluent sheets of large atypical cells with strong membranous staining. The large cells have vesicular, irregular nuclei and are closely packed, with only rare interspersed negative small cells and unstained vessels. The sheet-like growth of large positive B cells, in contrast to the scattered LP cells of typical NLPHL, is consistent with progression to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in the setting of nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: THRLBCL has scattered large B cells comprising a minority (<10%) in a T-cell/histiocyte background, whereas this field shows confluent sheets of large B cells.
Variant NLPHL shows LP cells as individual or small clusters, not confluent sheets as seen here.
Morphology is identical; separation relies on a concurrent or prior NLPHL component in the specimen or history.
